name: proto-blocks/oit-about-hero
title: OIT About Hero
description: About / company-overview page header. Auto-derived breadcrumb, headline, supporting paragraph, optional awards/cert logo row, large featured image on the right, two-color giant background wordmark. Light theme only.

wordmarkPrimary.label: Wordmark — Primary (light grey)
wordmarkPrimary.help: Giant background wordmark, first segment. Paints in light-grey. Leave empty to hide this half.

wordmarkAccent.label: Wordmark — Accent (pink)
wordmarkAccent.help: Giant background wordmark, second segment. Paints in soft pink. Leave empty to hide this half.

highlightWord.label: Highlight word/phrase in title
highlightWord.help: First case-insensitive occurrence in the title is wrapped in a red span.
